title: Dan Li
text:
Dan Li
  
    
      I write. I code. I turn complex ideas into experiences that people can see, play, and remember.
      Independent scholar, writer, and methodologist who bridges philosophy, coding, and design to create clarity.
      
      
        
      
    
  

  
    
      About
      Philosophy taught me how to think clearly about complexity; coding gave me tools to make that complexity visible; independence gave me the space to integrate them into one practice. Core values: clarity, elegance, openness, and craft.
      
      
        
      
    
  

  
    
      Work
      Two sides of one craft — Writing and Studio as a single practice.
      
      

      
      
        Studio
        Method-first boutique work. Seven-step method (open access). Selected case study, e.g., Ryan’s site.
      

      
        Writing
        Unlawful Laws (blurb), essays and reflections, selected publications.
      
    
  

  
    
      Contact
      
        
        Start a conversation
        Boutique, method‑first collaborations. Limited availability.
      
    
  

  
    © 2025 Dan Li · GitHub
